main_text.l: quidem, quod sciam, Scriptura; sed איש
non leve discrimen :) eò sequi, ut &
difperfos dicat: vereor ne ratio eos
fugerit. Longè enim aliud est (si quid
secundum linguas suas: id est, pro eo-
dem populo habitos, quibus communis e-
sset lingua; pro diverso autem, qui
si non longo, post tempore, cùm jam
sam planè coaluissent. Sanè si id vo-
luisset sacra Scriptura, quod ex illâ
colligunt viri docti, mirum, cùm capite
varietate scribere. Neque puto, si difperf-
hoc, ubi linguarum mentio fit, sæpius

page.notes: The Hebrew and Greek words in the line "populos ... vel ... in quo" and "verborum" are only approximately legible at this resolution; the Hebrew forms are copied as best as possible. The Greek word after "verborum" is doubtful and marked [?]. The "XI." numeral is printed with an overline and is copied as printed.
